findings.key_quote: Three Months Ended June 30, 2026 Google Search & other Paid clicks change 13 % Cost-per-click change 3 %
findings.justification: E1 has period_status UNKNOWN because it covers both three and six months ended June 30, 2026. The passage states multiple durations without clearly separating the figures. While it shows paid clicks increased 13% for the three months ended June 30, 2026, the UNKNOWN period_status means this cannot be ENTAILS or CONTRADICTS per the instructions. The evidence is on topic regarding paid clicks growth but does not definitively settle the assertion due to period ambiguity.

findings.key_quote: Google Search & other revenues increased $9.1 billion and $18.8 billion from the three and six months ended June 30, 2025 to the three and six months ended June 30, 2026. The overall growth was driven by interrelated factors including increases in search queries resulting from growth in user adoption and usage on mobile devices; growth in advertiser spending; and improvements we have made in ad formats and delivery.
findings.justification: E6 has period_status MISMATCH (6M vs 3M). While it discusses the three months ended June 30, 2026, the passage combines three and six month figures without clear separation. The filing attributes growth to multiple interrelated factors including search queries, advertiser spending, and ad improvements, but does not isolate paid clicks as the primary driver. This is on topic but does not settle whether paid clicks were the primary cause.

findings.key_quote: Changes in paid clicks and impressions are driven by a number of interrelated factors, including changes in advertiser spending; ongoing product and policy changes; and, as it relates to paid clicks, fluctuations in search queries resulting from changes in user adoption and usage, primarily on mobile devices.
